local data={
	["The Endministrator (Employment Contract)"]={name="The Endministrator (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="The Endministrator is a Sword-wielding guard who deals Physical DMG.", desc="Endministrator's employment contract. \"You might be the Endministrator, but protocol and directive have necessitated these formalities...\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Perlica (Employment Contract)"]={name="Perlica (Employment Contract)", tier=5, use="Perlica is an Arts Unit-wielding caster who deals Electric DMG.", desc="Perlica's employment contract. \"Our Supervisor might be very young, yet she has conveyed the Endfield vision to everyone.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Chen Qianyu (Employment Contract)"]={name="Chen Qianyu (Employment Contract)", tier=5, use="Chen Qianyu is a Sword-wielding guard who deals Physical DMG.", desc="Chen Qianyu's employment contract. \"Let me check how many times Operator Chen challenged other Endfielders to a spar... 	["Wulfgard (Employment Contract)"]={name="Wulfgard (Employment Contract)", tier=5, use="Wulfgard is a Handcannon-wielding caster who deals Heat DMG.", desc="Wulfgard's employment contract. \"Trust this skilled hunter of the Pack to help you deal with frontiersmates and Landbreakers.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Arclight (Employment Contract)"]={name="Arclight (Employment Contract)", tier=5, use="Arclight is a Sword-wielding vanguard who deals Electric DMG.", desc="Arclight's employment contract. \"I really want to know how Operator Arclight understands this world as a scabhta of the Hannabit Circuit... 	["Ember (Employment Contract)"]={name="Ember (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Ember is a Greatsword-wielding defender who deals Heat DMG.", desc="Ember's employment contract. \"Though ever the razor blade and ferric bastion, her Crusade has yet to end.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Xaihi (Employment Contract)"]={name="Xaihi (Employment Contract)", tier=5, use="Xaihi is an Arts Unit-wielding supporter who deals Cryo DMG.", desc="Xaihi's employment contract. \"I have no choice but to endorse Xaihi's exceptional abilities in living together with various mechanical contraptions. 	["Avywenna (Employment Contract)"]={name="Avywenna (Employment Contract)", tier=5, use="Avywenna is a Polearm-wielding striker who deals Electric DMG.", desc="Avywenna's employment contract. \"She is incredibly motivated and passionate... 	["Gilberta (Employment Contract)"]={name="Gilberta (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Gilberta is an Arts Unit-wielding supporter who deals Nature DMG.", desc="Gilberta's employment contract. \"Complex hues of color, infinite possibilities, plus a dash of sweetness.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Snowshine (Employment Contract)"]={name="Snowshine (Employment Contract)", tier=5, use="Snowshine is a Greatsword-wielding defender who deals Cryo DMG.", desc="Snowshine's employment contract. \"Well, at least little miss reliable Snowshine is in the SAR team.\" Many operators will tell themselves this when receiving missions in extreme environments.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Lifeng (Employment Contract)"]={name="Lifeng (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Lifeng is a Polearm-wielding guard who deals Physical DMG.", desc="Lifeng's employment contract. \"Simple, sincere, understanding... 	["Laevatain (Employment Contract)"]={name="Laevatain (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Laevatain is a Sword-wielding striker who deals Heat DMG.", desc="Laevatain's employment contract. \"Do not fear the fire... Simply walk with her to create lasting moments together.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Yvonne (Employment Contract)"]={name="Yvonne (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Yvonne is a Handcannon-wielding caster who deals Cryo DMG.", desc="Yvonne's employment contract. \"Her unique approach and modus operandi are proof of her ingenuity. 	["Da Pan (Employment Contract)"]={name="Da Pan (Employment Contract)", tier=5, use="Da Pan is a Greatsword-wielding striker who deals Physical DMG.", desc="Da Pan's employment contract. \"What about Operator Da Pan's friendly and easy-going nature? 	["Akekuri (Employment Contract)"]={name="Akekuri (Employment Contract)", tier=4, use="Akekuri is a Sword-wielding vanguard who deals Heat DMG.", desc="Akekuri's employment contract. \"More than just a top graduate of a business school who recommended herself to Endfield Industries. 	["Catcher (Employment Contract)"]={name="Catcher (Employment Contract)", tier=4, use="Catcher is a Greatsword-wielding defender. 	["Estella (Employment Contract)"]={name="Estella (Employment Contract)", tier=4, use="Estella is a Polearm-wielding guard who deals Cryo DMG.", desc="Estella's employment contract. \"You can trust Estella on anything EXCEPT life. 	["Fluorite (Employment Contract)"]={name="Fluorite (Employment Contract)", tier=4, use="Fluorite is a Handcannon-wielding caster who deals Nature DMG.", desc="Fluorite's employment contract. \"Actually, none of the operators felt that she deliberately committed the mischief. 	["Antal (Employment Contract)"]={name="Antal (Employment Contract)", tier=4, use="Antal is an Arts Unit-wielding supporter who deals Electric DMG.", desc="Antal's employment contract. \"Operator Antal is indeed a suitable teammate, given his talents in the Originium Arts... 	["Alesh (Employment Contract)"]={name="Alesh (Employment Contract)", tier=5, use="Alesh is a Sword-wielding vanguard who deals Cryo DMG.", desc="Alesh's employment contract. \"If you have time, you can go angling with him and visit his fin stall for a rich selection of live fins, fresh intel, or the next lucky person he might catch for that day.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Ardelia (Employment Contract)"]={name="Ardelia (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Ardelia is an Arts Unit-wielding supporter who deals Nature DMG.", desc="Ardelia's employment contract. \"Follow her light, gentle strides, listen to the murmurs of the land, and heal the suffering and pain of this planet.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Last Rite (Employment Contract)"]={name="Last Rite (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Last Rite is a Greatsword-wielding striker who deals Cryo DMG.", desc="Last Rite's employment contract. \"Please, you can come a little closer, Miss Last Rite. 	["Pogranichnik (Employment Contract)"]={name="Pogranichnik (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Pogranichnik is a Sword-wielding vanguard who deals Physical DMG.", desc="Pogranichnik's employment contract. \"A Liberi garrisoned at the border forts of Civilization. 	["Tangtang (Employment Contract)"]={name="Tangtang (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Tangtang is a Handcannon-wielding caster who deals Cryo DMG.", desc="Tangtang's employment contract. \"Once Tangtang approves of you, she'll do everything it takes to get you out of trouble. 	["Rossi (Employment Contract)"]={name="Rossi (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Rossi is a Sword-wielding guard who deals Physical DMG.", desc="Rossi's employment contract. \"If you disrespect the most treasured gem of the Pack, you disrespect everyone in the Pack.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Zhuang Fangyi (Employment Contract)"]={name="Zhuang Fangyi (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Zhuang Fangyi is a striker who wields Arts Units and deals Electric DMG.", desc="Zhuang Fangyi's employment contract. \"No matter how long Winter may last, Spring shall be here as promised.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Mi Fu (Employment Contract)"]={name="Mi Fu (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Mi Fu is a Greatsword-wielding guard. She deals Physical DMG.", desc="Mi Fu's employment contract. \"Your safety is now part of her job.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Camille (Employment Contract)"]={name="Camille (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Camille is a polearm-wielding vanguard who deals Heat DMG.", desc="Camille's employment contract. \"His blood will be with you, wherever you may be.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Arcane (Employment Contract)"]={name="Arcane (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Arcane is an Arts Unit-wielding caster who deals Nature DMG.", desc="Arcane's employment contract. \"The little fowl that never rested has finally found a place to perch.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Liino (Employment Contract)"]={name="Liino (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Liino is a Polearm-wielding supporter who deals Electric DMG.", desc="Liino's employment contract. \"Raise your head and see her, the most brilliant star of the evening sky.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
	["Typhoeus (Employment Contract)"]={name="Typhoeus (Employment Contract)", tier=6, use="Typhoeus is an Arts Unit-wielding striker who deals Cryo[sic] DMG.", desc="Typhoeus's employment contract. \"Follow her trail, gain insights on the revelations of Samivegr, and head deeper in the wilderness.\"", obtain="Headhunting"},
